author: China Insights
description:
The U.S. has moved to block the Strait of Hormuz — one of the world’s most critical energy chokepoints — but this is not just a military move. In this episode, we reconstruct what happened after the collapse of U.S.–Iran negotiations, and explain why Trump suddenly shifted from “clearing the strait” to fully restricting access. By connecting past operations in Venezuela, Iran’s shadow oil networks, and the global energy system, we break down a much larger strategy: controlling oil flows, reshaping global supply chains, and challenging China’s energy lifeline. This is not just about Iran — it’s about who controls the future of global energy and power.

#Iran #Trump #StraitOfHormuz #Oil #Geopolitics #China #GlobalEnergy #Analysis
title: The Strait Is Blocked — Trump’s Real Strategy Behind the Hormuz Shutdown I China Insights

author: China Insights
description:
She started as a factory seamstress — and ended up controlling billions in prime Beijing real estate. But how did Chen Lihua really build her empire? This episode traces her rise from humble beginnings to becoming one of China’s richest women, uncovering the key turning points, controversial deals, and political connections behind her fortune. We also explore the transformation of Beijing’s historic neighborhoods, and the personal story that captured public attention for decades — her marriage to a famous actor. With her passing, the question is no longer just about wealth, but about legacy, power, and what was left behind.

#China #Business #Wealth #RealEstate #Beijing #Billionaire #Analysis
title: From Seamstress to Billionaire: The Untold Story Behind China’s Richest Woman I China Insights
